content:
**Lane ship refuses unless its caller declares itself and no test runner is behind it (#1012)**

**What**: cli.mjs ship calls decideShipInvoker() (brain/scripts/memory/lib/ship-invoker.mjs) as its first statement, before any module load, credential read or VCS call. It refuses unless --invoker is hook|sweep|manual and, independently, whenever NODE_TEST_CONTEXT is set; BRAIN_VCS_TEST_MODULE and --dry-run are the only bypasses. session-end-ship.mjs passes hook, day-start-sweep.mjs passes sweep, the memory:ship scripts pass manual; the child env is unchanged (A2); --json echoes the invoker so e2e tests prove the marker survived. test-spawn-hygiene.test.mjs requires every test spawn of a brain entrypoint to be allowlisted with a closed-set reason (no-vcs-capability, fixture-root-local-git, vcs-port-substituted, refusal-asserted). An anti-pattern draft waits in the change's brain-drafts/ for maintainer promotion.
**Why**: PR #1007 was shipped and auto-merged by npm test because a test's safety rested on the lane flag being off; #1013 fixed that test, #1012 closes the class.
**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/{cli.mjs,lib/ship-invoker.mjs,session-end-ship.mjs,day-start-sweep.mjs}, package.json, brain/scripts/test-spawn-hygiene.test.mjs, test/lane-ship-invoker.e2e.test.mjs, openspec/changes/issue-1012-lane-ship-invoker-guard/.
**Learned**: the day-start sweep also spawns ship, which an npm-script env marker would have refused; an argv marker declared by each caller is portable and visible at the spawn line. NODE_TEST_CONTEXT is set by node --test and survives spawn and npm run. The spawn inventory was 141 runtime spawns; the seven flagged by the #1013 review were safe for three structural reasons, none a seam variable, so a seam-presence check would have been the anti-pattern itself.
